$comment: English descriptions for the props whose .d.ts has no JSDoc, keyed "Interface.prop". The JSDoc in the .d.ts wins when there is one; scripts/docs-props.mjs falls back to this file and says when a prop has neither.
ButtonProps.variant: primary (accent fill), secondary (surface and edge), soft (soft accent), ghost (no chrome), danger.
ButtonProps.size: sm 30 px, md 38 px, lg 46 px tall.
ButtonProps.loading: Shows a spinner instead of the left icon, hides the right one, and turns the button off while it keeps focus (`aria-disabled`, `aria-busy`).
IconButtonProps.variant: ghost (no chrome), secondary (surface and edge), primary (accent fill).
IconButtonProps.size: sm 30 px, md 38 px, lg 46 px square.
FileButtonProps.disabled: Disabled: takes neither focus nor clicks.
CheckboxProps.label: The text beside the box.
CheckboxProps.description: A line under the text, in `--fg-3`.
CheckboxProps.indeterminate: Partly checked (a dash instead of a tick). Set on the native input.
RadioProps.label: The text beside the button.
RadioProps.description: A line under the text, in `--fg-3`.
SwitchProps.label: The text beside the switch.
SwitchProps.description: A line under the text, in `--fg-3`.
BadgeProps.outline: Transparent with an edge instead of a fill.
BadgeProps.children: The text, one or two words.
CardProps.variant: outlined (edge, no shadow), raised (shadow, for things that float), sunken (sunken surface, for wells and quotes).
CardProps.padding: none, sm 12 px, md 20 px, lg 32 px.
TagProps.onClick: A click on the tag (the toggle).
ListItemProps.title: The title, required.
ScrollRowProps.children: What sits in the row: tags, dots, tabs.
ToastProps.tone: Which icon it gets, and the icon's colour.
ToastProps.title: One line, past tense for what was done: "Task archived".
ToastProps.actionLabel: The text of the action, usually "Undo".
ToastProps.onAction: Called when the action is pressed.
ToastProps.onClose: Shows a close button (×) that calls this.
InputProps.label: The label above the field.
InputProps.hint: Help text under the field, linked with `aria-describedby`.
InputProps.size: sm 30 px, md 38 px, lg 46 px tall.
FieldProps.label: The label.
FieldProps.error: Error message; shown instead of the hint, with `role="alert"`.
FieldProps.optional: Adds the optional marker after the label.
FieldProps.optionalLabel: The text of the optional marker.
FieldProps.htmlFor: The control's id, so the label points at it.
FieldProps.hintId: The id the hint or error gets. Default `${htmlFor}-hint`; point the control's `aria-describedby` at it.
SelectProps.label: The label above the field.
SelectProps.hint: Help text under the field, linked with `aria-describedby`.
SelectProps.error: Error message. Replaces the hint, sets `aria-invalid` and is announced.
SelectProps.optional: Adds a quiet "Valgfritt" after the label.
SelectProps.options: The options: strings, or `{ value, label }`.
SelectProps.placeholder: A first, empty option with this text.
SelectProps.size: sm 30 px, md 38 px, lg 46 px tall.
TextareaProps.label: The label above the field.
TextareaProps.hint: Help text under the field, linked with `aria-describedby`.
TextareaProps.error: Error message. Replaces the hint, sets `aria-invalid` and is announced.
TextareaProps.optional: Adds a quiet "Valgfritt" after the label.
TabsProps.defaultValue: The tab selected at first (uncontrolled). Otherwise the first.
TabsProps.onChange: Called when a tab is selected, with its `id`.
TabsProps.variant: underline for sections of a page, segmented for view switches and filters.
TabItem.id: The key; `value` and `TabPanel value` point at it.
TabItem.label: The text on the tab.
TabItem.icon: Lucide icon name before the text.
TabItem.count: A number after the text, in monospace.
AppShellProps.onNavigate: Called on a click on an item, with its `id`.
AppShellItem.label: The text. One word is best.
DialogProps.onClose: Called by Esc, a click on the scrim and the close button. Without it there is no close button, and Esc and the scrim do nothing.
DialogProps.title: The heading; names the dialog (`aria-labelledby`).
DialogProps.description: A line under the heading; describes the dialog (`aria-describedby`).
SussiProps.pose: The pose: hode, ligger, titter, sover, strekk, sitter.
AlertProps.onAction: Called when the action is pressed.
AlertProps.className: Your own classes on the alert.
AlertProps.style: Your own styles on the alert.
SpinnerProps.className: Your own classes on the spinner.
SpinnerProps.style: Your own styles on the spinner.
SkeletonProps.className: Your own classes on the skeleton.
SkeletonProps.style: Your own styles on the skeleton.
